name: Simone Vardy

statedReqs.notes: Wants the broken one. 'Nine two on today's numbers, and I will fix today's numbers.'

hiddenPrefs.desc: Deferred capital is a shopping list to her, not a reason to leave — as long as it is on paper before she signs.
Took a flat roof to the deck on her last project and swore off buying another one. Everything else is a line item; a roof is a year.

intro: Buys the building everyone else walked out of, and has the spreadsheet open before she is back in the car.
